info.name: vNext Test - Version Consistency
info.description:
Auto-generated to mirror C# integration tests in tests/Core/Tests/version-consistency-test-workflow/. Each folder maps to one [Fact]. Authoritative version source: GET /instances/{id}.flowVersion (format: '{semver}-pkg.{pkg}+{domain}', e.g. '2.0.0-pkg.1.0.0+core').

Prerequisite: both v1.0.0 and v2.0.0 published. New instances pin to latest (v2.0.0).

item.name: S1: V2 Happy Path (full flow + data contract + version pin)
item.description: Maps to V2HappyPath_FullFlow_DataContract_ReachesCompletedState. Asserts flowVersion semver == '2.0.0' at start and at completion, and validates data contract at every state.

item.name: S1.9 Final state == completed-state, status == C
S1.10 Final data (v2Completed, completedByVersion=2.0.0, NO v1Completed)
S2: Parallel Instances — Both reach completed independently
S3: Parallel Instances — Different speeds
item.description: Maps to ParallelInstances_DifferentSpeeds_AWaitsWhileBCompletes. A stays on processing while B finishes the full path; then A completes.

item.name: S4: Idempotent Start + Version Pinning (CRITICAL)
item.description:
Maps to IdempotentStart_V1Instance_RemainsOnV1Path_NotUpgradedToV2.

CRITICAL: Re-posting start with the SAME key MUST return the SAME instance id, and flowVersion MUST remain unchanged. (E.g. an instance started on v1.0.0 must remain on v1.0.0 after a second start call, never auto-upgraded.)

request.description: Set s4Key collection variable in the test script for use in subsequent requests.

item.name: S4.4 Second start with SAME key (idempotent)

exec: pm.test('Same instance id returned', function () { pm.expect(json.id).to.eql(first); });

item.name: S4.5 flowVersion AFTER second start (must equal BEFORE)
S5: Path Selection Driven by Actual flowVersion
item.description: Maps to PathSelection_DrivenByActualFlowVersion_ReachesVersionAppropriateCompletedState. Read flowVersion first, then drive the path that matches the version.

item.name: S5.4 State after complete-processing (depends on version)
S5.5 approve-review (run only if v2 — for v1 this is a no-op/error)
S5.8 Version pin unchanged after completion
S6: flowVersion Stability Across Lifecycle
item.description: Maps to FlowVersion_StableAcrossLifecycle_NeverChanges. flowVersion captured at processing-state must equal flowVersion at review-state and at completed-state.

item.name: S6.4 flowVersion at review-state (must equal S6.2)
S6.6 flowVersion at completed-state (must equal S6.2)
